slide1.title: Добро пожаловать в CubicLauncher!
slide1.desc: Русский: A modern, fast Minecraft launcher. Manage multiple instances, mods, Java configurations and more. Let's take a quick tour!

slide2.title: Русский: Which account would you like to use?
slide2.desc: Русский: Choose an account type to set it up now. You can add more accounts or switch the active account from your profile later.

accounts.later: You can also click Далее and set up your account later.

slide3.title: Ваши инстансы
slide3.desc: Русский: Instances are separate Minecraft installations. View and select your instances here. Each one can have its own version, mods and configuration.

slide4.title: Создать инстанс
slide4.desc: Русский: Use this button to create a new instance. Choose a name, version, loader (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge) and a custom icon.

slide5.title: Русский: Download Versions
slide5.desc: Русский: Download Minecraft versions here. Get official releases, snapshots, alphas and Fabric versions to use in your instances.

slide6.title: Настройки
slide6.desc: Русский: The Settings panel has three sections: Launcher, Minecraft and Java. Let's look at each one.

slide7.title: Разделы настроек
slide7.desc: Русский: Use the tabs to navigate between Launcher (language, themes, updates), Minecraft (RAM, versions, console) and Java (runtimes, arguments).

slide8.title: Конфигурация Java
slide8.desc: Русский: Manage Java 8, 17, 21 and 25 runtimes here. Install Java automatically from the launcher or use an existing installation. You can also configure JVM arguments and environment variables.

slide9.title: Русский: License
slide9.desc: Русский: CubicLauncher is free software released under the GNU General Public License v3.
